newsitem.title: USA: SANYO N. America consolidates in U.S.
newsitem.headline: SANYO N. America consolidates in U.S.

text.p: SANYO North America Corp, a division of Sanyo Electric Co Ltd, said on Monday that it was consolidating its major U.S. operations and designating San Diego as its new headquarters.
SANYO North America was formed from the October 1 merger between SANYO North America Corp, SANYO Fisher (USA) Corp and SANYO Sales and Supply (USA) Corp.

The reorganization also brought together six other major Sanyo Group sales, marketing and manufacturing companies as well as four service and support entities, all as subsidiaries of the new SANYO North America Corp, the company said.
The North American Group companies had mostly operated as separate autonomous entities, the company said.

"The consolidation of sales and marketing, manufacturing and service and support companies, including customer service, logistics and finance, will enable us to better meet the needs of our customers, leading to strengthened competitiveness and improved profitability," said Masafumi Matsunaga, president and chief operating officer of SANYO North America Corp.
"Each company will continue to be accountable for the market in which it operates, but will now have the backing of the entire organization," he said.
